RigidBodyObject.restitution: Bounciness. 0 stays put after landing, 1 bounces back as high as it fell.
RigidBodyObject.use_margin: Lets you set your own collision margin instead of the default.
RigidBodyObject.collision_margin: A small padding around the shape where collisions count. Bigger is more stable but shows a gap.
RigidBodyObject.collision_collections: The collision groups the object belongs to. Objects only collide if they share a group.

RigidBodyWorld._: The global settings of the rigid body physics world, such as speed and accuracy.
RigidBodyWorld.enabled: Turns the whole rigid body simulation on or off.
RigidBodyWorld.time_scale: Speed of the simulation. 1 is normal, 2 is double speed, 0.5 is slow motion.
RigidBodyWorld.substeps_per_frame: Physics steps per frame. More is more accurate for fast objects but slower.
RigidBodyWorld.solver_iterations: How many times per step the solver fixes contacts and joints. Higher is steadier but slower.
RigidBodyWorld.use_split_impulse: Stops objects from gaining extra speed when they overlap and get pushed apart. May be less stable.

ClothSettings._: The cloth material settings: how heavy, stiff and stretchy the fabric is, plus pressure and sewing.
ClothSettings.goal_min: The lowest pin strength after scaling vertex group weights. 0 means free to move.
ClothSettings.goal_max: The highest pin strength after scaling vertex group weights. 1 means fully stuck.
ClothSettings.goal_default: Pin strength for every vertex when no vertex group is set.
ClothSettings.goal_spring: How strongly the cloth is pulled toward its goal position. Higher holds it tighter.
ClothSettings.goal_friction: How much the goal spring is slowed down. Higher gives less bouncing.
ClothSettings.internal_friction: Friction between hair strands inside a hair simulation. Higher makes hair stick together.
ClothSettings.collider_friction: Friction between hair and colliders. Higher makes hair grip objects.
ClothSettings.density_target: Highest hair density allowed before hairs push each other apart.
ClothSettings.density_strength: How strongly hair is pushed apart when it gets too dense. Higher gives a stronger push.
ClothSettings.mass: Weight of each cloth point. Heavier cloth hangs and moves like thick fabric.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_mass: Vertex group that pins parts of the cloth in place. Painted points stay fixed.
ClothSettings.gravity: The pull applied to the cloth, as X, Y, Z. Default is Earth's gravity pulling down.
ClothSettings.air_damping: Air drag slowing the cloth. Low lets it fall fast like silk, high makes it flutter slowly like paper.
ClothSettings.pin_stiffness: How strongly pinned points are held. Higher holds tighter.
ClothSettings.quality: Simulation steps per frame. Higher is more accurate and less jittery but slower.
ClothSettings.time_scale: Multiplies cloth speed. 1 is normal, lower is slow motion, higher is faster.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_shrink: Vertex group that controls where the cloth shrinks. Painted areas shrink more.
ClothSettings.shrink_min: How much the cloth shrinks. Positive shrinks it, negative makes it grow.
ClothSettings.shrink_max: The most shrinking applied at fully painted areas of the vertex group.
ClothSettings.voxel_cell_size: Size of the grid cells used for hair interaction. Smaller is more detailed but slower.
ClothSettings.tension_damping: Slows stretching motion. Higher stops the cloth from bouncing after being pulled.
ClothSettings.compression_damping: Slows squashing motion. Higher stops bouncing when the cloth is pushed together.
ClothSettings.shear_damping: Slows sideways skewing motion. Higher makes the cloth settle faster.
ClothSettings.tension_stiffness: How much the cloth resists stretching. Low is like stretchy fabric, high is like denim.
ClothSettings.tension_stiffness_max: Stiffness used where the vertex group is fully painted for tension.
ClothSettings.compression_stiffness: How much the cloth resists being squashed together. Higher makes fewer wrinkles.
ClothSettings.compression_stiffness_max: Stiffness used where the vertex group is fully painted for compression.
ClothSettings.shear_stiffness: How much the cloth resists sideways skewing. Higher keeps the weave square.
ClothSettings.shear_stiffness_max: Stiffness used where the vertex group is fully painted for shear.
ClothSettings.sewing_force_max: Largest force allowed when sewing edges together. Higher pulls seams closed harder.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_structural_stiffness: Vertex group that sets where the cloth is stiffer against stretching.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_shear_stiffness: Vertex group that sets where the cloth is stiffer against skewing.
ClothSettings.bending_stiffness: How much the cloth resists folding. Low is silk with soft folds, high is stiff like leather.
ClothSettings.bending_stiffness_max: Stiffness used where the bending vertex group is fully painted.
ClothSettings.bending_damping: Slows folding motion. Higher stops the cloth from wobbling when it bends.
ClothSettings.use_sewing_springs: Pulls loose edges together so you can stitch pieces of cloth.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_bending: Vertex group that sets where the cloth is stiffer against bending.
ClothSettings.use_dynamic_mesh: Lets the cloth follow changes in the base mesh, like shape keys or animation.
ClothSettings.bending_model: Chooses how bending forces are calculated.
ClothSettings.bending_model.ANGULAR: Modern model that bends based on the angle between faces. More realistic.
ClothSettings.bending_model.LINEAR: Older model using simple springs. Kept for old files.
ClothSettings.use_internal_springs: Adds springs inside the cloth connecting opposite sides, so thick things like pillows keep their volume.
ClothSettings.internal_spring_normal_check: Only connects internal springs to points facing the opposite way. Helps avoid wrong links.
ClothSettings.internal_spring_max_length: Longest distance an internal spring can have when created. Longer allows connecting thicker parts.
ClothSettings.internal_spring_max_diversion: How far internal spring rays may bend from the surface direction. Higher makes more connections.
ClothSettings.internal_tension_stiffness: How much the internal springs resist stretching.
ClothSettings.internal_tension_stiffness_max: Internal tension stiffness at fully painted vertex group areas.
ClothSettings.internal_compression_stiffness: How much the internal springs resist being squashed.
ClothSettings.internal_compression_stiffness_max: Internal compression stiffness at fully painted vertex group areas.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_intern: Vertex group that sets where internal springs are stronger.
ClothSettings.use_pressure: Simulates air pressure inside a closed mesh, so it can inflate like a balloon.
ClothSettings.use_pressure_volume: Uses your Target Volume value as the starting volume instead of measuring it.
ClothSettings.uniform_pressure_force: Constant pressure pushing out from inside. Positive inflates, negative squeezes.
ClothSettings.target_volume: The volume where inside and outside pressure match. 0 means it is measured from the starting shape.
ClothSettings.pressure_factor: Outside air pressure in kPa. Higher outside pressure squeezes the object more.
ClothSettings.fluid_density: Density of the liquid inside, like water, making the lower part press out more.
ClothSettings.vertex_group_pressure: Vertex group choosing where pressure applies. No paint means no pressure.

ClothCollisionSettings._: How cloth collides with other objects and with itself.
ClothCollisionSettings.use_collision: Lets the cloth hit other objects so it drapes over them instead of passing through.
ClothCollisionSettings.distance_min: The gap kept between cloth and colliders. Higher keeps cloth further away from surfaces.
ClothCollisionSettings.friction: How much cloth grips colliders. Higher makes it slide less.
ClothCollisionSettings.damping: How much speed is lost on impact. Higher means less bounce.
ClothCollisionSettings.collision_quality: Collision checks per step. Higher stops cloth from poking through but is slower.
ClothCollisionSettings.impulse_clamp: Limits the push from collisions to avoid explosions. 0 turns the limit off.
ClothCollisionSettings.use_self_collision: Lets the cloth hit itself, so folds do not pass through each other.
ClothCollisionSettings.self_distance_min: Gap kept between cloth parts that touch themselves. Higher keeps folds apart.
ClothCollisionSettings.self_friction: Grip between parts of the cloth that touch each other.
ClothCollisionSettings.vertex_group_self_collisions: Vertex group of triangles that skip self collision.
ClothCollisionSettings.vertex_group_object_collisions: Vertex group of triangles that skip collision with other objects.
ClothCollisionSettings.self_impulse_clamp: Limits the push from self collisions to avoid instability. 0 turns the limit off.

CollisionSettings._: Makes an object a collider that particles, cloth and soft bodies can bounce off.
CollisionSettings.use: Turns this object into a collider that physics systems react to.
CollisionSettings.damping_factor: Speed lost by particles on impact. 0 bounces freely, 1 stops them.
CollisionSettings.damping_random: Random variation in damping for each hit. Higher makes bounces more varied.
CollisionSettings.friction_factor: How much particles slow down while sliding on the surface.
CollisionSettings.friction_random: Random variation in friction. Higher makes sliding less even.
CollisionSettings.permeability: Chance that a particle passes through the surface. 0 never, 1 always.
CollisionSettings.use_particle_kill: Particles that hit the object die.
CollisionSettings.stickiness: How much particles stick to the surface when they hit. Higher holds them more.
CollisionSettings.thickness_inner: Thickness inside the surface used by soft bodies. Higher keeps them further away on the inside.
CollisionSettings.thickness_outer: Thickness outside the surface. Higher keeps things further from the surface.
CollisionSettings.damping: Speed lost when soft bodies or cloth hit. Higher means less bounce.
CollisionSettings.absorption: Percent of force field strength absorbed by the object. 100 blocks the force fully.
CollisionSettings.cloth_friction: How much cloth grips the surface. Higher stops sliding.
CollisionSettings.use_culling: Cloth only collides from the front side of the surface, which helps it recover from poking through.
CollisionSettings.use_normal: Collision pushes along the surface normal, which is more reliable in some cases.

SoftBodySettings._: The settings of a soft body, a mesh that wobbles and deforms like jelly or rubber.
SoftBodySettings.friction: General drag slowing point movement. Higher makes the body move like it is in thick liquid.
SoftBodySettings.mass: How heavy the soft body is. Heavier sags and moves less.
SoftBodySettings.vertex_group_mass: Vertex group that sets different weights for different points.
SoftBodySettings.gravity: Strength of gravity pulling the soft body down. 0 floats, 9.8 is Earth.
SoftBodySettings.speed: Speed of the simulation. Higher is faster and more energetic.
SoftBodySettings.vertex_group_goal: Vertex group that sets how strongly points stick to their original shape.
SoftBodySettings.goal_min: Lowest goal strength after scaling the vertex group. 0 means free movement.
SoftBodySettings.goal_max: Highest goal strength after scaling the vertex group. 1 means fully held.
SoftBodySettings.goal_default: Goal strength when no vertex group is used. Higher holds the shape more.
SoftBodySettings.goal_spring: How strongly points are pulled back to their goal position. Higher is stiffer.
SoftBodySettings.goal_friction: Slows the goal spring. Higher reduces wobble.
SoftBodySettings.pull: Edge spring stiffness when stretched. Higher resists stretching.
SoftBodySettings.push: Edge spring stiffness when squashed. Higher resists squashing.
SoftBodySettings.damping: Friction of edge springs. Higher stops wobble sooner.
SoftBodySettings.spring_length: Changes spring length as a percent to shrink or inflate. 0 turns it off.
SoftBodySettings.aero: Makes edges catch the wind like a sail. Higher gives a stronger effect.
SoftBodySettings.plastic: Lets the body stay permanently bent after being deformed. Higher keeps more of the dent.
SoftBodySettings.bend: How much the body resists bending. Higher makes it stiffer.
SoftBodySettings.shear: How much the body resists skewing sideways. Higher makes it hold its shape.
SoftBodySettings.vertex_group_spring: Vertex group that sets where edge springs are stronger.
SoftBodySettings.collision_type: Chooses how the size of the collision balls around points is set.
SoftBodySettings.collision_type.MANUAL: You set the ball size yourself.
SoftBodySettings.collision_type.AVERAGE: Ball size is the average spring length times the Ball Size value.
SoftBodySettings.collision_type.MINIMAL: Ball size is the shortest spring length times the Ball Size value.
SoftBodySettings.collision_type.MAXIMAL: Ball size is the longest spring length times the Ball Size value.
SoftBodySettings.collision_type.MINMAX: Ball size is the middle of the shortest and longest spring, times Ball Size.
SoftBodySettings.ball_size: Size of the collision balls around points. Larger balls collide earlier.
SoftBodySettings.ball_stiff: How hard the collision balls push back. Higher is firmer.
SoftBodySettings.ball_damp: Blend toward soft, no-bounce collisions. Higher absorbs more energy.
SoftBodySettings.error_threshold: Solver accuracy limit. Low is more precise and slower, high is faster and less exact.
SoftBodySettings.step_min: Fewest solver steps per frame. Higher is steadier.
SoftBodySettings.step_max: Most solver steps per frame. Higher allows more precision when needed.
SoftBodySettings.choke: Thickness of the thick-liquid feel inside the collision. Higher slows movement inside.
SoftBodySettings.fuzzy: Looseness during collisions. Higher makes collisions faster but less stable.
SoftBodySettings.use_auto_step: Picks the number of steps automatically based on how fast points move.
SoftBodySettings.use_diagnose: Prints performance info in the console, for finding slow settings.
SoftBodySettings.use_estimate_matrix: Saves the estimated position, rotation and scale of the body for scripts.
SoftBodySettings.location_mass_center: The estimated balance point of the soft body.
SoftBodySettings.rotation_estimate: The estimated rotation of the soft body.
SoftBodySettings.scale_estimate: The estimated scale of the soft body.
SoftBodySettings.use_goal: Pulls points back toward their animated position, like an elastic tether.
SoftBodySettings.use_edges: Makes edges behave like springs, giving the body its stretchiness.
SoftBodySettings.use_stiff_quads: Adds diagonal springs to four-sided faces so squares do not collapse.
SoftBodySettings.use_edge_collision: Edges also collide with objects, not only the points.
SoftBodySettings.use_face_collision: Faces also collide with objects. More exact but can be very slow.
SoftBodySettings.aerodynamics_type: Chooses how air pushes on the edges.
SoftBodySettings.aerodynamics_type.SIMPLE: Edges feel a drag from the air around them.
SoftBodySettings.aerodynamics_type.LIFT_FORCE: Edges feel drag and also lift when moving through air, like a wing.
SoftBodySettings.use_self_collision: Points collide with other points of the same body using simple balls.

FluidDomainSettings._: The box that holds a smoke, fire or liquid simulation, with its resolution, physics, detail, caching and display settings.
FluidDomainSettings.additional_res: Most extra cells the adaptive domain may add. Higher allows the simulation to grow bigger.
FluidDomainSettings.adapt_margin: Extra cells kept around the fluid so it does not touch the domain edge.
FluidDomainSettings.adapt_threshold: Smallest amount of smoke, fuel or heat a cell needs to be kept. Higher trims the domain more.
FluidDomainSettings.use_adaptive_domain: Shrinks and grows the simulation box to fit the fluid, which saves time and memory.
FluidDomainSettings.resolution_max: Detail of the simulation along the longest side. Higher is sharper but much slower and heavier.
FluidDomainSettings.use_collision_border_front: The front wall of the domain acts as a solid wall. Fluid cannot leave through it.
FluidDomainSettings.use_collision_border_back: The back wall of the domain acts as a solid wall. Fluid cannot leave through it.
FluidDomainSettings.use_collision_border_right: The right wall of the domain acts as a solid wall. Fluid cannot leave through it.
FluidDomainSettings.use_collision_border_left: The left wall of the domain acts as a solid wall. Fluid cannot leave through it.
FluidDomainSettings.use_collision_border_top: The top of the domain acts as a solid ceiling. Fluid cannot leave through it.
FluidDomainSettings.use_collision_border_bottom: The bottom of the domain acts as a solid floor. Fluid cannot leave through it.
FluidDomainSettings.gravity: Gravity pulling the fluid as X, Y, Z. Default pulls down like Earth. Set to 0 for floating.
FluidDomainSettings.domain_type: Chooses whether the simulation is gas (smoke and fire) or liquid (water).
FluidDomainSettings.delete_in_obstacle: Removes fluid that ends up inside an obstacle object.
FluidDomainSettings.alpha: How strongly dense smoke rises. Higher makes smoke rise faster.
FluidDomainSettings.beta: How strongly hot smoke rises. Higher makes smoke rise faster.
FluidDomainSettings.dissolve_speed: How many frames smoke takes to fade away. Lower makes it vanish faster.
FluidDomainSettings.vorticity: Amount of swirl in the smoke. Higher gives more curling motion.
FluidDomainSettings.highres_sampling: How the high-detail grid reads the emitter flow.
FluidDomainSettings.highres_sampling.FULLSAMPLE: Samples every cell fully. Best quality, slowest.
FluidDomainSettings.highres_sampling.LINEAR: Blends between neighbors. Smooth and quick.
FluidDomainSettings.highres_sampling.NEAREST: Takes the nearest cell. Fastest but blocky.
FluidDomainSettings.use_dissolve_smoke: Makes smoke fade away over time.
FluidDomainSettings.use_dissolve_smoke_log: Smoke fades fast at first and then lingers longer, a more natural look.
FluidDomainSettings.burning_rate: Speed of burning. Higher burns faster and makes smaller flames.
FluidDomainSettings.flame_smoke: How much smoke the burning fuel makes. Higher gives more smoke.
FluidDomainSettings.flame_vorticity: Extra swirl added to flames. Higher gives more flickering.
FluidDomainSettings.flame_ignition: Lowest flame temperature. Higher makes flames rise faster.
FluidDomainSettings.flame_max_temp: Highest flame temperature. Higher makes flames rise faster.
FluidDomainSettings.flame_smoke_color: The color of smoke made by burning fuel.
FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength: How strong the added noise detail is. Higher gives more small swirls.
FluidDomainSettings.noise_pos_scale: Size of the noise swirls. Higher gives larger swirls.
FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim: How fast the noise changes in time. Higher makes details move faster.
FluidDomainSettings.noise_scale: How many times more detailed the noise grid is than the base grid. Higher is more detail and slower.
FluidDomainSettings.use_noise: Adds extra fine detail to smoke using a cheaper high-resolution pass.
FluidDomainSettings.simulation_method: Chooses how the liquid is simulated.
FluidDomainSettings.simulation_method.FLIP: Splashy and energetic liquid, though it can be noisy.
FluidDomainSettings.simulation_method.APIC: More stable, energetic and rotation-aware liquid. A good default.
FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio: Mix of FLIP and PIC. 1 is full FLIP (splashy), lower is smoother and more stable.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_randomness: Random placement of liquid particles. Higher is more random, lower is orderly.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_number: Particles per cell. Higher gives finer liquid but is slower.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_min: Least particles allowed in a cell. Higher keeps thin liquid parts solid.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_max: Most particles allowed in a cell. Lower saves memory.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_radius: Size of liquid particles. Raise if liquid seems to lose volume, lower if it gains.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_band_width: Thickness of the particle layer at the liquid surface. Higher means more particles.
FluidDomainSettings.use_flip_particles: Creates a particle system from the liquid, for showing particles.
FluidDomainSettings.use_fractions: Smooths how liquid meets obstacles, so the edge is less blocky.
FluidDomainSettings.fractions_threshold: How much liquid is allowed inside an obstacle cell. Higher treats more cells as obstacles.
FluidDomainSettings.fractions_distance: How far fluid is kept from obstacles. Higher pushes liquid away from them.
FluidDomainSettings.sys_particle_maximum: The most liquid particles the simulation may have. 0 means no limit.
FluidDomainSettings.use_viscosity: Uses a special solver for thick liquids like honey.
FluidDomainSettings.viscosity_value: Thickness of the liquid. Higher is thicker, like honey or lava.
FluidDomainSettings.use_diffusion: Shows settings like viscosity and surface tension for thick or sticky liquids.
FluidDomainSettings.surface_tension: How much the liquid pulls itself into blobs. Higher makes more beads and round drops.
FluidDomainSettings.viscosity_base: The base number of the viscosity. It is multiplied by 10 to the power of minus the exponent.
FluidDomainSettings.viscosity_exponent: Makes the viscosity smaller by powers of ten. Higher makes the liquid thinner.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_concave_upper: Upper limit for smoothing dents in the surface. Higher fills dents more.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_concave_lower: Lower limit for smoothing dents in the surface. Higher fills dents more.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_smoothen_pos: Smooths bumps that stick out of the liquid surface. Higher is smoother.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_smoothen_neg: Smooths dents going into the liquid surface. Higher is smoother.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_scale: Makes the surface mesh finer than the base grid by this factor. Higher is more detail and slower.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_generator: Chooses how the liquid surface mesh is built from particles.
FluidDomainSettings.use_mesh: Builds a smooth liquid surface mesh. Needed to render liquid as a solid shape.
FluidDomainSettings.use_speed_vectors: Saves the speed of the mesh points so renders can show motion blur.
FluidDomainSettings.mesh_particle_radius: Size of particles when building the mesh. Higher gives fatter, smoother surfaces.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_min_wavecrest: Lowest value for marking cells as wave crests. Lower makes more cells count as crests.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_max_wavecrest: Highest value for marking cells as wave crests. Higher lets more cells count as crests.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_min_trappedair: Lowest value for marking cells with trapped air. Lower makes more cells count.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_max_trappedair: Highest value for marking cells with trapped air. Higher lets more cells count.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_min_energy: Fluid speed where cells start to make particles. Lower starts earlier.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_max_energy: Fluid speed where cells stop making more particles. Higher keeps making more.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_sampling_wavecrest: Most particles made per wave crest cell each frame. Higher gives more spray.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_sampling_trappedair: Most particles made per trapped air cell each frame. Higher gives more bubbles.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_bubble_buoyancy: How strongly bubbles rise. Higher makes bubbles float up more than they travel with the flow.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_bubble_drag: How much bubbles are carried by the liquid. Higher makes them follow the flow.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_life_min: Shortest life of the extra particles. Higher keeps them around longer.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_life_max: Longest life of the extra particles. Higher keeps them around longer.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_boundary: What to do with extra particles that leave the domain.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_boundary.DELETE: Deletes extra particles that are in obstacles or left the domain.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_boundary.PUSHOUT: Pushes extra particles that left the domain back inside.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_combined_export: Chooses how spray, foam and bubbles are grouped into particle systems.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_combined_export.OFF: Makes a separate particle system for each type.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_combined_export.SPRAY_FOAM: Spray and foam share one particle system.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_combined_export.SPRAY_BUBBLE: Spray and bubbles share one particle system.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_combined_export.FOAM_BUBBLES: Foam and bubbles share one particle system.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_combined_export.SPRAY_FOAM_B: One particle system holds spray, foam and bubbles.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_potential_radius: Radius for working out where extra particles appear. Higher is smoother but slower.
FluidDomainSettings.sndparticle_update_radius: Radius for moving each extra particle. Higher is smoother but slower.
FluidDomainSettings.particle_scale: Makes the extra particle grid finer than the base grid by this factor. Higher is more detail and slower.
FluidDomainSettings.use_spray_particles: Makes spray particles, small drops flying above the liquid.
FluidDomainSettings.use_bubble_particles: Makes bubble particles under the liquid surface.
FluidDomainSettings.use_foam_particles: Makes foam particles floating on the liquid surface.
FluidDomainSettings.use_tracer_particles: Makes tracer particles that follow the flow, good for seeing movement.
FluidDomainSettings.guide_alpha: How strongly guiding steers the fluid. Higher follows the guide more but lags.
FluidDomainSettings.guide_beta: Size of the guiding swirls. Higher gives larger swirls.
FluidDomainSettings.guide_vel_factor: Scales guiding speed. Higher gives faster guide movement.
FluidDomainSettings.guide_source: Chooses where guiding speeds come from.
FluidDomainSettings.guide_source.DOMAIN: Uses another baked fluid domain as the guide.
FluidDomainSettings.guide_source.EFFECTOR: Uses guiding objects (effectors) to steer the fluid.
FluidDomainSettings.use_guide: Turns on guiding, which steers the fluid using a guide.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_start: First frame that is baked into the cache.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_end: Last frame that is baked into the cache.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_offset: Shifts the cached animation in time when loading. Used to start a baked simulation later or earlier.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_pause_data: The frame where the main data bake was paused, so it can be resumed.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_pause_noise: The frame where the noise bake was paused, so it can be resumed.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_pause_mesh: The frame where the mesh bake was paused, so it can be resumed.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_pause_particles: The frame where the particle bake was paused, so it can be resumed.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_frame_pause_guide: The frame where the guiding bake was paused, so it can be resumed.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_type: Chooses how the simulation is baked (saved).
FluidDomainSettings.cache_type.REPLAY: Simulates as you play the timeline. Simple but slow for big scenes.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_type.MODULAR: Bake each stage (data, noise, mesh, particles) on its own.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_resumable: Saves extra data so baking can be paused and continued later. Uses more disk space.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_directory: The folder where the baked fluid files are stored.
FluidDomainSettings.is_cache_baking_data: True while the main simulation data is being baked.
FluidDomainSettings.has_cache_baked_data: True if the main simulation data is already baked.
FluidDomainSettings.is_cache_baking_noise: True while the noise is being baked.
FluidDomainSettings.has_cache_baked_noise: True if the noise is already baked.
FluidDomainSettings.is_cache_baking_mesh: True while the surface mesh is being baked.
FluidDomainSettings.has_cache_baked_mesh: True if the surface mesh is already baked.
FluidDomainSettings.is_cache_baking_particles: True while the particles are being baked.
FluidDomainSettings.has_cache_baked_particles: True if the particles are already baked.
FluidDomainSettings.is_cache_baking_guide: True while the guiding is being baked.
FluidDomainSettings.has_cache_baked_guide: True if the guiding is already baked.
FluidDomainSettings.is_cache_baking_any: True while any part of the simulation is being baked.
FluidDomainSettings.has_cache_baked_any: True if any part of the simulation is already baked.
FluidDomainSettings.export_manta_script: Saves the Mantaflow script that runs the simulation, for developers.
FluidDomainSettings.openvdb_cache_compress_type: Chooses how OpenVDB cache files are compressed.
FluidDomainSettings.openvdb_cache_compress_type.BLOSC: Fast, multi-core compression with similar size to ZIP.
FluidDomainSettings.openvdb_cache_compress_type.NONE: No compression. Biggest files but quickest.
FluidDomainSettings.openvdb_data_depth: How many bits are stored per value. Fewer bits give smaller files but less precision.
FluidDomainSettings.time_scale: Speed of the simulation. 1 is normal, lower is slow motion, higher is faster.
FluidDomainSettings.use_adaptive_timesteps: Automatically uses several smaller steps per frame when the fluid moves fast.
FluidDomainSettings.cfl_condition: Largest speed per cell allowed. Higher uses fewer steps but can become unstable.
FluidDomainSettings.timesteps_min: Fewest simulation steps per frame. Higher is more accurate and slower.
FluidDomainSettings.timesteps_max: Most simulation steps per frame. Higher allows more accuracy for fast fluid.
FluidDomainSettings.use_slice: Shows only one flat slice of the volume in the viewport.
FluidDomainSettings.slice_axis: Chooses the direction the viewport slice faces.
FluidDomainSettings.slice_axis.AUTO: Picks the direction that faces your view.
FluidDomainSettings.slice_per_voxel: Number of slices drawn per voxel. Higher looks smoother but is slower.
FluidDomainSettings.slice_depth: Where the slice sits through the domain, from 0 to 1.
FluidDomainSettings.display_thickness: How thick the smoke looks in the viewport. Higher is denser looking.
FluidDomainSettings.display_interpolation: How smoke and fire are smoothed when shown in the viewport.
FluidDomainSettings.display_interpolation.CUBIC: Smoother and higher quality but slower.
FluidDomainSettings.show_gridlines: Shows the grid lines of the simulation cells in the viewport.
FluidDomainSettings.show_velocity: Shows arrows or lines for the speed of the fluid.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_display_type: Chooses how vectors are drawn in the viewport.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_display_type.NEEDLE: Draws each vector as a small needle.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_display_type.STREAMLINE: Draws vectors as flowing lines following the field.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_display_type.MAC: Draws vectors as a MAC grid, the layout the solver uses.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_field: Chooses which vector field is shown.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_field.FLUID_VELOCITY: Shows how fast the fluid is moving.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_field.GUIDE_VELOCITY: Shows the speed of the guiding field.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_field.FORCE: Shows the force acting on the fluid.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_show_mac_x: Shows the X part of the MAC grid vectors.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_show_mac_y: Shows the Y part of the MAC grid vectors.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_show_mac_z: Shows the Z part of the MAC grid vectors.
FluidDomainSettings.vector_scale: Makes the shown vectors longer or shorter. Only changes the display.
FluidDomainSettings.use_color_ramp: Colors the voxel grid using a color ramp, to look at values like density or heat.
FluidDomainSettings.color_ramp_field: Chooses which value is colored in the grid display.
FluidDomainSettings.color_ramp_field_scale: Multiplier for the colored field. Higher makes small values show up stronger.
FluidDomainSettings.clipping: Values below this are treated as empty and not drawn. Higher speeds up the viewport.
FluidDomainSettings.gridlines_color_field.FLAGS: Colors gridlines by cell type (fluid, obstacle, empty).
FluidDomainSettings.gridlines_color_field.RANGE: Highlights cells whose values are inside the chosen range.
FluidDomainSettings.gridlines_lower_bound: Bottom of the value range that gets highlighted.
FluidDomainSettings.gridlines_upper_bound: Top of the value range that gets highlighted.
FluidDomainSettings.gridlines_range_color: The color used to highlight cells in the range.
FluidDomainSettings.gridlines_cell_filter: Chooses which cell types are highlighted.
FluidDomainSettings.velocity_scale: Strength of motion blur from the fluid motion. Higher gives longer blur streaks.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_mesh_format: File type used to save the baked surface data.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_mesh_format.OPENVDB: OpenVDB (.vdb), the industry standard for volumes. Compact and widely supported.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_mesh_format.RAW: Raw uncompressed files (.raw). Large but simple.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_data_format: File type used to save the baked volume (smoke or liquid grid) data.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_data_format.OPENVDB: OpenVDB (.vdb), the industry standard for volumes. Compact and widely supported.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_data_format.RAW: Raw uncompressed files (.raw). Large but simple.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_particle_format: File type used to save the baked particle data.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_particle_format.OPENVDB: OpenVDB (.vdb), the industry standard for volumes. Compact and widely supported.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_particle_format.RAW: Raw uncompressed files (.raw). Large but simple.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_noise_format: File type used to save the baked noise data.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_noise_format.OPENVDB: OpenVDB (.vdb), the industry standard for volumes. Compact and widely supported.
FluidDomainSettings.cache_noise_format.RAW: Raw uncompressed files (.raw). Large but simple.

FluidFlowSettings._: Settings of an object that adds smoke, fire or liquid to a fluid simulation, or removes it.
FluidFlowSettings.density: How thick the smoke is as it is emitted. Higher gives denser smoke.
FluidFlowSettings.smoke_color: The color of the smoke that is emitted.
FluidFlowSettings.fuel_amount: How much fuel is burned, so how big the flames are. Higher gives bigger flames.
FluidFlowSettings.temperature: How much hotter the emitted fluid is than the air. Higher makes it rise faster.
FluidFlowSettings.flow_type: Chooses what this object adds to the simulation.
FluidFlowSettings.flow_behavior: Chooses whether this object adds, removes or only shapes the fluid.
FluidFlowSettings.flow_behavior.INFLOW: Adds fluid to the simulation, like a tap.
FluidFlowSettings.flow_behavior.OUTFLOW: Removes fluid from the simulation, like a drain.
FluidFlowSettings.flow_behavior.GEOMETRY: Uses the object as the fluid shape only, with no continuous emission.
FluidFlowSettings.flow_source: Chooses where on the object fluid comes from.
FluidFlowSettings.use_absolute: Density is set to the given value in the emitter area and does not build up on top.
FluidFlowSettings.use_initial_velocity: Gives the fluid some starting speed when it is emitted.
FluidFlowSettings.velocity_factor: How much of the emitter object's own movement is passed to the fluid. Higher passes more.
FluidFlowSettings.velocity_normal: Speed pushing the fluid outward from the surface. Higher shoots it out faster.
FluidFlowSettings.velocity_random: Random speed given to the fluid. Higher makes it burst chaotically.
FluidFlowSettings.velocity_coord: Extra starting speed in X, Y and Z added to the other speeds.
FluidFlowSettings.volume_density: How much fluid comes from inside the mesh. Higher gives more emission from the inside.
FluidFlowSettings.surface_distance: How far above the mesh surface fluid is emitted. Higher makes a thicker layer.
FluidFlowSettings.use_plane_init: Treats the mesh as a flat, open sheet, so fluid only comes from the surface.
FluidFlowSettings.particle_size: Size of liquid particles in cells. Higher makes bigger particles.
FluidFlowSettings.use_particle_size: Lets you set the particle size yourself instead of using the nearest cell.
FluidFlowSettings.use_inflow: Switch to start and stop the flow. Animate it to turn the source on and off.
FluidFlowSettings.subframes: Extra samples between frames. Higher improves fast moving sources but is slower.
FluidFlowSettings.density_vertex_group: Vertex group that sets how much fluid comes out of each part of the surface.
FluidFlowSettings.use_texture: Uses a texture to vary the emission strength.
FluidFlowSettings.texture_map_type: Chooses how the texture is placed on the emitter.
FluidFlowSettings.texture_map_type.AUTO: Generated coordinates centered on the flow object.
FluidFlowSettings.texture_map_type.UV: Uses a UV map for the texture placement.
FluidFlowSettings.uv_layer: Name of the UV map used for the emission texture.
FluidFlowSettings.texture_size: Scale of the emission texture. Higher makes bigger texture features.
FluidFlowSettings.texture_offset: Moves the texture in the Z direction.

FieldSettings._: A force field that pushes, pulls, swirls or slows particles, cloth, soft bodies and other physics.
FieldSettings.type: Chooses what kind of force the field applies.
FieldSettings.type.BOID: A force that acts as a predator or goal for boid creatures.
FieldSettings.type.CHARGE: A spherical force based on particle charge. Same charges repel, opposite attract.
FieldSettings.type.GUIDE: Pulls particles along a curve object, like a rail.
FieldSettings.type.DRAG: A force that slows movement down, like moving through thick air.
FieldSettings.type.FLUID_FLOW: A force taken from the speeds of a fluid simulation.
FieldSettings.type.FORCE: A push or pull straight toward or away from the center of the object.
FieldSettings.type.HARMONIC: A spring force that pulls things back to the field's center, like a bouncy rubber band.
FieldSettings.type.LENNARDJ: A force from the Lennard-Jones model. Particles repel up close and attract at a distance, like atoms.
FieldSettings.type.MAGNET: A force that depends on how fast particles move, bending their path sideways.
FieldSettings.type.TEXTURE: A force whose strength comes from a texture.
FieldSettings.type.TURBULENCE: A random swirling force made from a noise pattern.
FieldSettings.type.VORTEX: A spiraling force that twists things around the object, like a whirlpool.
FieldSettings.type.WIND: A steady push along the object's local Z axis, like wind.
FieldSettings.shape: Chooses the shape that the force spreads from.
FieldSettings.shape.POINT: The force comes from the object's center.
FieldSettings.shape.LINE: The force comes from the object's local Z axis line.
FieldSettings.shape.PLANE: The force comes from the object's flat local XY plane.
FieldSettings.shape.SURFACE: The force comes from the object's surface.
FieldSettings.shape.POINTS: The force comes from every vertex of the object.
FieldSettings.falloff_type: Chooses the shape of the area where the force fades with distance.
FieldSettings.falloff_type.CONE: The force fades in a cone shape.
FieldSettings.falloff_type.SPHERE: The force fades evenly in all directions, like a ball.
FieldSettings.falloff_type.TUBE: The force fades in a tube shape around the axis.
FieldSettings.texture_mode: Chooses how the texture is turned into a force. Curl and RGB need a color texture.
FieldSettings.texture_mode.CURL: Uses the swirl of the texture's colors to make a rotating force.
FieldSettings.texture_mode.GRADIENT: Pushes toward the brighter parts of the texture, like rolling uphill.
FieldSettings.texture_mode.RGB: Uses the red, green and blue values of the texture as X, Y and Z force.
FieldSettings.z_direction: Chooses if the force works above, below or both sides of the field's Z axis.
FieldSettings.z_direction.POSITIVE: The force only works on the positive Z side.
FieldSettings.z_direction.NEGATIVE: The force only works on the negative Z side.
FieldSettings.z_direction.BOTH: The force works on both sides.
FieldSettings.strength: How strong the force is. Positive pushes away, negative pulls in. Higher is stronger.
FieldSettings.linear_drag: Slowing that grows with speed. Higher stops movement faster.
FieldSettings.harmonic_damping: Slows the spring force so bouncing dies out. Higher stops wobbling faster.
FieldSettings.quadratic_drag: Slowing that grows very quickly with speed. Higher strongly stops fast things.
FieldSettings.flow: Turns the force into moving air that drags things along. Higher makes stronger air flow.
FieldSettings.wind_factor: How much the force is lessened when it blows along a surface like cloth. 1 means not reduced at all.
FieldSettings.inflow: Inward pull in a vortex. Positive pulls things toward the center, negative pushes out.
FieldSettings.size: Size of the turbulence swirls. Higher gives bigger, slower swirls.
FieldSettings.rest_length: The distance where the spring force is zero. Beyond it, things are pulled back in.
FieldSettings.falloff_power: How quickly the force fades with distance. Higher drops off faster.
FieldSettings.distance_min: Distance within which the force is full strength before fading.
FieldSettings.distance_max: Distance after which the force has no effect.
FieldSettings.radial_min: Radial distance within which the force is full strength before fading.
FieldSettings.radial_max: Radial distance after which the force has no effect.
FieldSettings.radial_falloff: How fast the force fades sideways from the axis. 2 matches real gravity.
FieldSettings.texture_nabla: Size of the small step used to measure texture slope. Smaller is more exact but noisier.
FieldSettings.noise: Random variation added to the force strength. Higher is more chaotic.
FieldSettings.seed: Changes the random noise pattern. Try another number for a different result.
FieldSettings.use_min_distance: Turns on the minimum distance, so the force is full strength close in.
FieldSettings.use_max_distance: Turns on the maximum distance, so the force stops after a certain range.
FieldSettings.use_radial_min: Turns on the minimum radial distance.
FieldSettings.use_radial_max: Turns on the maximum radial distance.
FieldSettings.use_object_coords: Uses the object's coordinates to place the texture, so the pattern moves with the field.
FieldSettings.use_global_coords: Uses world coordinates for the turbulence, so the pattern stays in place when the field moves.
FieldSettings.use_2d_force: Pushes only in 2D, ignoring the Z direction.
FieldSettings.use_root_coords: Uses the position where the particle started for the texture instead of where it is now.
FieldSettings.apply_to_location: The force changes where particles are.
FieldSettings.apply_to_rotation: The force changes how particles spin.
FieldSettings.use_absorption: Collision objects block the force so it does not pass through them.
FieldSettings.use_multiple_springs: Each point is pulled by multiple springs, not only the nearest one.
FieldSettings.use_smoke_density: Changes the force depending on the smoke density. Denser smoke is affected more.
FieldSettings.use_gravity_falloff: Force gets weaker with the square of distance, like real gravity.
FieldSettings.guide_minimum: Distance from the curve within which particles are fully pulled in.
FieldSettings.guide_free: Part of the particle's end of life during which the guide stops affecting it.
FieldSettings.use_guide_path_add: Adds a share of the whole path based on distance, rather than just pulling toward it.
FieldSettings.use_guide_path_weight: Uses the curve's weights to change how strongly it pulls along its length.
FieldSettings.guide_clump_amount: How much particles gather toward the curve. Positive gathers, negative spreads.
FieldSettings.guide_clump_shape: Shapes the clumping toward the start or end of the curve.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_type: Chooses a pattern that makes particles curl and wave along the curve.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_type.NONE: No pattern. Particles follow the curve straight.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_type.BRAID: Particles weave around each other like a braid.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_type.RADIAL: Particles bend outward from the curve.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_type.ROLL: Particles roll around the curve like a barrel.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_axis: Chooses the axis that the pattern offsets along.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_axis.X: The pattern offsets along the X axis.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_axis.Y: The pattern offsets along the Y axis.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_axis.Z: The pattern offsets along the Z axis.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_frequency: How many times the pattern repeats. Higher gives tighter waves.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_shape: Shifts the pattern toward the start or end of the curve.
FieldSettings.guide_kink_amplitude: How far the pattern pushes away from the curve. Higher is a bigger effect.

MeshUVLoopLayer._: One UV map of a mesh, which tells how a flat picture wraps around the 3D shape.
MeshUVLoopLayer.active: Makes this the UV map you see and edit in the UV editor.
MeshUVLoopLayer.active_render: Makes this the UV map used when rendering, so textures use it.
MeshUVLoopLayer.active_clone: Makes this the UV map the Clone brush copies from in texture painting.

GreasePencil._: The data of a Grease Pencil drawing: its layers, strokes and onion-skin settings for 2D drawing and animation.
GreasePencil.use_fake_user: Keeps this item saved in the file even if nothing uses it. Without it, unused items are deleted when you save and reopen.
GreasePencil.use_extra_user: An internal flag that marks the item as having one more user. Normally you never need to touch it.
GreasePencil.is_runtime_data: Marks data that Blender builds while running and does not save in the .blend file. Mostly for add-on developers.
GreasePencil.tag: A scratch flag that tools use to mark data for their own work. Its starting value is not reliable, so ignore it.
GreasePencil.use_autolock_layers: Locks every layer except the one you are on, so you cannot draw on the wrong layer.
GreasePencil.stroke_depth_order: Chooses how strokes are sorted when drawn in 3D space.
GreasePencil.stroke_depth_order.2D: Strokes are stacked by layer and draw order, like paper on a desk.
GreasePencil.stroke_depth_order.3D: Strokes are sorted by their real 3D position, so they can pass through each other.
GreasePencil.ghost_before_range: How many frames before the current one show as onion skins. 0 shows none.
GreasePencil.ghost_after_range: How many frames after the current one show as onion skins. 0 shows none.
GreasePencil.use_ghost_custom_colors: Lets you choose the colors of the onion skin frames yourself.
GreasePencil.before_color: Color of the onion skins from earlier frames.
GreasePencil.after_color: Color of the onion skins from later frames.
GreasePencil.onion_mode: Chooses which frames are shown as onion skins.
GreasePencil.onion_mode.ABSOLUTE: Shows frames within a range of frame numbers around the current one.
GreasePencil.onion_mode.RELATIVE: Shows the previous and next keyframes of the drawing, not by frame number.
GreasePencil.onion_mode.SELECTED: Shows only the keyframes that you selected.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type: Only shows onion skins from keyframes of the chosen type.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type.KEYFRAME: Normal keyframes, such as main poses.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type.BREAKDOWN: Breakdown poses, used between key poses.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type.MOVING_HOLD: Keyframes that are part of a moving hold, a pose with slight motion.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type.EXTREME: Extreme poses, the most exaggerated points of a move.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type.JITTER: Filler or baked keyframes, such as keys on every frame.
GreasePencil.onion_keyframe_type.GENERATED: Keyframes created automatically by a tool, not by hand.
GreasePencil.use_onion_fade: Fades onion skins out the farther they are from the current frame.
GreasePencil.use_onion_loop: Shows the start frame as an onion skin at the end of a looping animation.
GreasePencil.onion_factor: How visible the onion skins are. 0 invisible, 1 fully solid.

Armature._: A skeleton of bones used to pose and deform characters, plus how the bones are shown.
Armature.use_fake_user: Keeps this item saved in the file even if nothing uses it. Without it, unused items are deleted when you save and reopen.
Armature.use_extra_user: An internal flag that marks the item as having one more user. Normally you never need to touch it.
Armature.is_runtime_data: Marks data that Blender builds while running and does not save in the .blend file. Mostly for add-on developers.
Armature.tag: A scratch flag that tools use to mark data for their own work. Its starting value is not reliable, so ignore it.
Armature.pose_position: Chooses whether the skeleton shows its pose or its resting shape.
Armature.pose_position.POSE: Shows the bones in the pose you have made.
Armature.pose_position.REST: Shows the bones in their rest (binding) position, ignoring posing.
Armature.display_type: Chooses how bones are drawn in the viewport.
Armature.display_type.OCTAHEDRAL: Bones are drawn as pointy diamond shapes. The default.
Armature.display_type.STICK: Bones are drawn as thin lines with dots at the ends.
Armature.display_type.BBONE: Bones are drawn as boxes that show their bendy segments.
Armature.display_type.ENVELOPE: Bones are drawn as stretched balls showing their deform area.
Armature.display_type.WIRE: Bones are drawn as thin wires that show the segments and curves.
Armature.show_axes: Shows the direction axes of each bone.
Armature.axes_position: Where the axes sit on each bone. 0 is at the base, 1 at the tip.
Armature.relation_line_position: Chooses where the dotted line between a parent and child bone starts.
Armature.relation_line_position.TAIL: The line starts from the parent bone's tail (end).
Armature.relation_line_position.HEAD: The line starts from the parent bone's head (start).
Armature.show_names: Shows the name of each bone in the viewport.
Armature.use_mirror_x: Edits to a bone are copied to the matching bone on the other side (like arm.L and arm.R).
Armature.show_bone_custom_shapes: Shows bones with their custom shapes instead of the standard bone shape.
Armature.show_bone_colors: Shows the colors you gave to the bones.

Bone._: One bone of a skeleton as stored in the rest pose: what it deforms, how it inherits, and bendy bone settings.
Bone.display_type: Chooses how this bone is drawn in the viewport.
Bone.display_type.ARMATURE_DEFINED: Uses the style set on the whole armature.
Bone.display_type.OCTAHEDRAL: Draws the bone as a pointy diamond shape.
Bone.display_type.STICK: Draws the bone as a thin line with dots at the ends.
Bone.display_type.BBONE: Draws the bone as a box that shows its bendy segments.
Bone.display_type.ENVELOPE: Draws the bone as a stretched ball showing its deform area.
Bone.display_type.WIRE: Draws the bone as a thin wire.
Bone.use_inherit_rotation: The bone follows its parent's rotation. Off lets it keep its own direction.
Bone.use_envelope_multiply: Combines vertex group weights with the envelope for deformation, so the effect is reduced by distance.
Bone.use_deform: Lets the bone bend the mesh. Off for control bones that should not move the mesh.
Bone.inherit_scale: Chooses how this bone follows the scale of its parent.
Bone.inherit_scale.FULL: Follows all of the parent's scaling.
Bone.inherit_scale.FIX_SHEAR: Follows the parent's scaling but removes slanted stretching.
Bone.inherit_scale.ALIGNED: Rotates uneven parent scaling to line up with this bone's own axes.
Bone.inherit_scale.AVERAGE: Follows only the parent's overall size, evenly on every axis.
Bone.inherit_scale.NONE_LEGACY: Ignores the parent's scaling in the old way, without correcting the position. Kept for old files.
Bone.use_local_location: Moves the bone along its own axes instead of the parent's.
Bone.use_relative_parent: Objects parented to this bone follow it like deformed geometry, with relative movement.
Bone.show_wire: Always draws the bone as a wireframe, even in solid view. Handy for non-deforming bones.
Bone.use_cyclic_offset: Old option for bones without a parent to receive cycle offset effects.
Bone.hide_select: Allows the bone to be selected. Off protects it from accidental clicks.
Bone.envelope_distance: How far from the bone the envelope reaches to bend nearby mesh. Higher affects more.
Bone.envelope_weight: Strength of the bone's envelope. Higher makes the bone pull the mesh more.
Bone.head_radius: Size of the envelope at the bone's head (start). Higher affects more mesh there.
Bone.tail_radius: Size of the envelope at the bone's tail (end). Higher affects more mesh there.
Bone.bbone_segments: Number of pieces a bendy bone is split into. More is smoother bending, 1 is a normal bone.
Bone.bbone_mapping_mode: Chooses how mesh points are matched to the pieces of a bendy bone.
Bone.bbone_mapping_mode.STRAIGHT: Fast and fine for most cases, but not exact on strongly curved bones.
Bone.bbone_mapping_mode.CURVED: Slower, but bends better on strongly curved bendy bones.
Bone.bbone_x: Width of the bendy bone display in X. Only changes how it looks.
Bone.bbone_z: Width of the bendy bone display in Z. Only changes how it looks.
Bone.bbone_handle_type_start: Chooses how the curve handle at the start of a bendy bone is decided.
Bone.bbone_handle_type_start.AUTO: Uses the connected parent and children to work out the handle.
Bone.bbone_handle_type_start.ABSOLUTE: Uses the position of a chosen bone.
Bone.bbone_handle_type_start.RELATIVE: Uses how far a chosen bone moved from its rest position.
Bone.bbone_handle_type_start.TANGENT: Uses the direction a chosen bone points.
Bone.bbone_handle_use_scale_start: The start handle bone's scale also changes the bendy bone's thickness at the start.

EditBone._: One bone while editing the skeleton: its position, roll, parent connection and bendy bone settings.
EditBone.display_type: Chooses how this bone is drawn in the viewport.
EditBone.display_type.ARMATURE_DEFINED: Uses the style set on the whole armature.
EditBone.display_type.OCTAHEDRAL: Draws the bone as a pointy diamond shape.
EditBone.display_type.STICK: Draws the bone as a thin line with dots at the ends.
EditBone.display_type.BBONE: Draws the bone as a box that shows its bendy segments.
EditBone.display_type.ENVELOPE: Draws the bone as a stretched ball showing its deform area.
EditBone.display_type.WIRE: Draws the bone as a thin wire.
EditBone.use_inherit_rotation: The bone follows its parent's rotation. Off lets it keep its own direction.
EditBone.use_envelope_multiply: Combines vertex group weights with the envelope for deformation, so the effect is reduced by distance.
EditBone.use_deform: Lets the bone bend the mesh. Off for control bones that should not move the mesh.
EditBone.inherit_scale: Chooses how this bone follows the scale of its parent.
EditBone.inherit_scale.FULL: Follows all of the parent's scaling.
EditBone.inherit_scale.FIX_SHEAR: Follows the parent's scaling but removes slanted stretching.
EditBone.inherit_scale.ALIGNED: Rotates uneven parent scaling to line up with this bone's own axes.
EditBone.inherit_scale.AVERAGE: Follows only the parent's overall size, evenly on every axis.
EditBone.inherit_scale.NONE_LEGACY: Ignores the parent's scaling in the old way, without correcting the position. Kept for old files.
EditBone.use_local_location: Moves the bone along its own axes instead of the parent's.
EditBone.use_relative_parent: Objects parented to this bone follow it like deformed geometry, with relative movement.
EditBone.show_wire: Always draws the bone as a wireframe, even in solid view. Handy for non-deforming bones.
EditBone.use_cyclic_offset: Old option for bones without a parent to receive cycle offset effects.
EditBone.hide_select: Allows the bone to be selected. Off protects it from accidental clicks.
EditBone.envelope_distance: How far from the bone the envelope reaches to bend nearby mesh. Higher affects more.
EditBone.envelope_weight: Strength of the bone's envelope. Higher makes the bone pull the mesh more.
EditBone.head_radius: Size of the envelope at the bone's head (start). Higher affects more mesh there.
EditBone.tail_radius: Size of the envelope at the bone's tail (end). Higher affects more mesh there.
EditBone.bbone_segments: Number of pieces a bendy bone is split into. More is smoother bending, 1 is a normal bone.
EditBone.bbone_mapping_mode: Chooses how mesh points are matched to the pieces of a bendy bone.
EditBone.bbone_mapping_mode.STRAIGHT: Fast and fine for most cases, but not exact on strongly curved bones.
EditBone.bbone_mapping_mode.CURVED: Slower, but bends better on strongly curved bendy bones.
EditBone.bbone_x: Width of the bendy bone display in X. Only changes how it looks.
EditBone.bbone_z: Width of the bendy bone display in Z. Only changes how it looks.
